newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Ciputra Development unit to issue bonds.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Ciputra Development unit to issue bonds.

text.p: PT Ciputra Surya, a subsidiary of PT Ciputra Development, said on Monday it plans to issue six-year 300 billion rupiah straight bonds in June.
The company said the bonds would carry 24 coupons ranging between 15.5 and 15.625 percent per annum.
It said the bonds, offered from June 10 to 12, will be listed on the Surabaya Stock Exchange on July 2.
It said funds raised will be used to refinance its short- and long-term loans and to strengthen its working capital.
Ciputra said the bonds, rated BBB by the Indonesian rating agency Pefindo, were managed by PT BNI Securities, PT Harita Kencana Securities and PT Peregrine Securities.
